security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code formatting, documentation links, and descriptive prose. One command example interpolates an unquoted campaign value, and one save instruction derives a filename from a campaign value; both require input validation before execution or writing.

remediation.issue: The ledger command accepts an unquoted campaign placeholder.
remediation.suggestion: Pass campaign values as validated, separate command arguments and reject shell metacharacters. Do not construct shell commands from user-provided campaign names.

remediation.issue: The save filename includes a campaign-derived value.
remediation.suggestion: Sanitize the campaign component to an allowlisted filename slug and resolve the final path within the intended memory directory before writing.

content.value_statement: Paid campaign changes can look successful without a fair control and fixed measurement window. This skill compares normalized ROAS or CPA evidence and returns a clear readback decision.
actual_capabilities: Defines a fixed readback window after a campaign exits learning phase.
Compares a campaign change with an unchanged control or holdout.
Normalizes attribution windows and currency before cross-platform comparison.
Classifies results as Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven.
Flags broken tracking or duplicate conversion evidence for auditor handoff.
Produces a labeled summary of measured, user-provided, and estimated figures.
limitations: Requires user-provided campaign, analytics, or ecommerce exports.
Does not access advertising platforms automatically.
Does not calculate ROI or CPA ratios independently.
Cannot prove causation when no suitable control is available.

use_cases.title: Review a budget increase
use_cases.description: Compare a budget increase with an unchanged campaign over the same fixed window.

use_cases.title: Assess a creative test
use_cases.description: Decide whether new creative should be promoted, retained for testing, or rolled back.

use_cases.title: Prepare a measurement handoff
use_cases.description: Document attribution issues and readback evidence for a marketing analyst or auditor.

prompt_templates.title: Start a simple readback
prompt_templates.prompt: Read back my Campaign X budget increase from two weeks ago. Compare ROAS with an unchanged control.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate new creative
prompt_templates.prompt: I changed creative on a prospecting ad set. Use my exported data to compare CPA with a sibling control over 14 days.

prompt_templates.title: Compare platforms carefully
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my Meta and Google campaigns using these CSV exports. Normalize attribution windows and currency before comparing ROAS.

prompt_templates.title: Handle tracking uncertainty
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this campaign change and these exports. Mark the result Unproven if tracking is inconsistent, and prepare an auditor handoff.

output_examples.input: Campaign X increased budget. ROAS was compared with an unchanged control for 14 days.
output: ROAS improved, but the difference did not pass the declared practical threshold.
Next readback: Review after seven additional days.

output_examples.input: New creative produced lower CPA than the control with matching attribution windows.
output: CPA beat the control over the fixed measurement window.
Evidence status: Measured exports and normalized attribution settings.

best_practices: Choose the control and readback window before reviewing results.
Normalize currency and attribution windows before comparing platforms.
Label each figure as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
anti_patterns: Do not judge a change from dashboard results without a control.
Do not compare ROAS across different attribution windows.
Do not treat a broken tracking signal as a confirmed campaign result.

faq.question: What data does this skill need?
faq.answer: Provide campaign exports and, when available, analytics or ecommerce exports for an independent conversion check.

faq.question: Does it connect to ad platforms?
faq.answer: No. Platform integrations are optional, and the skill can use manually exported files.

faq.question: What decisions can it return?
faq.answer: It returns Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven.

faq.question: Why is a control required?
faq.answer: A control helps separate the campaign change from seasonal or unrelated performance changes.

faq.question: Can it calculate ROAS and CPA?
faq.answer: It delegates ratio calculations to the related roi-calculator skill.

faq.question: What happens when tracking is unreliable?
faq.answer: The result is marked Unproven and the observations are prepared for an ad-account audit.
